Pharmacokinetics Pentachlorophenol may be absorbed after ingestion or inhalation or through the skin. After ingestion, the majority of a dose is eliminated in the urine as unchanged pentachlorophenol and its glucuronide, with small amounts appearing in the faeces. Uses Pentachlorophenol has been used mainly as the sodium salt (C6Cl5NaO = 288.3), as a preservative for a wide range of indus- trial and agricultural products, including wood and other build- ing materials, textiles, glues, and starch. It has also been used for the control of slime and algae, and as a molluscicide, fungicide, and herbicide. Permethrin (BAN, USAN, rINN)
